findings.detail: Slickdeals revolver with 06/2023 maturity appears in the December 31, 2022 SOI, while the June 30, 2023 SOI shows the current Slickdeals revolver maturity as 06/2024.
Loadmaster current unfunded revolver commitment is disclosed as of June 30, 2023 with a commitment expiration date of 12/31/2022 and unfunded commitment of 225.

rationale: Raw source supports the maturity_not_past flag. The Slickdeals 06/2023 row is localized to the December 31, 2022 comparative SOI; the current June 30, 2023 SOI instead shows Slickdeals revolver maturity as 06/2024, so any June-2023 report-date violation from that row is a comparative-period leak. Separately, the current commitments table reports Loadmaster Derrick & Equipment, Inc. with a 12/31/2022 revolver commitment expiration and a 225 unfunded commitment as of June 30, 2023, which is genuinely past the report date.
